supplements.title: Elephantopus scaber L.: phytochemistry, pharmacology, nanoformulation, and synthetic modification - a review.
supplements.summary: Elephantopus scaber, an Asian medicinal plant, contains compounds that kill cancer cells and reduce inflammation through multiple cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Inhibitory effects of mycosubtilin on proliferation of colon cancer SW480 cells.
supplements.summary: Mycosubtilin, a natural compound, outperformed standard chemotherapy in stopping colon cancer cell growth by triggering apoptosis.

supplements.title: PFAS is associated with perineural invasion in triple-negative breast cancer with a potential role for Cathepsin D dysregulation: a multi-omics and experimental study.
supplements.summary: PFAS pollutants may promote nerve invasion in triple-negative breast cancer through Cathepsin D dysregulation, with a natural compound showing promise as treatment.

supplements.title: Dendrobine inhibits the growth and invasion of human breast cancer cells by regulating the NF-κB signaling pathway via the SLC6A9 target.
supplements.summary: Dendrobine, a natural compound, stops breast cancer cell growth and spread by blocking the SLC6A9 protein and NF-κB signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Shaping Human Health and Nutrition Through Innovations in Spatial Metabolism.
supplements.summary: Spatial imaging technology reveals how diet reshapes tissue metabolism in cancer, liver disease, and brain health at high resolution.

supplements.title: In Vitro and In Vivo Study of Green-Synthesized Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles as a Novel Anticoccidial Agent.
supplements.summary: Green-synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles show promise as a new treatment for coccidiosis parasites in animals.

supplements.title: Can non-pharmacological strategies in cancer patients support perceived appetite? A scoping review.
supplements.summary: Non-pharmacological strategies like exercise and counseling may help improve appetite in cancer patients without medication.

supplements.title: From tumor reduction to behavioral improvement and cytokine balance: Therapeutic role of petroleum ether extract of Teucrium polium in a rat model of C6-induced glioblastoma.
supplements.summary: Teucrium polium extract reduced glioblastoma tumors and improved anxiety and motor function in rats, suggesting potential as a complementary brain cancer treatment.

supplements.title: Ketogenic Diet Prevents Obesity-Associated Pancreatic Cancer Independent of Weight Loss and Induces Pancreatic Metabolic Reprogramming.
supplements.summary: Ketogenic diet delays pancreatic cancer progression in obese mice through metabolic changes, independent of weight loss.

supplements.title: Effects of luteolin on proliferation and apoptosis of breast cancer cells by regulating EGFR/STAT3/AKt pathway.
supplements.summary: Luteolin, a natural compound, reduces breast cancer cell growth and increases cell death by blocking a key protein signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Plants and Plant-Derived Compounds Mediate Protection Across Diverse Pathological Conditions by Targeting the PANoptosis Pathways.
supplements.summary: Plant-derived compounds suppress PANoptosis pathways to protect against multiple diseases including cancer, heart disease, and organ injuries.

supplements.title: Limosilactobacillus reuteri promotes melatonin release from human intestinal organoids via 5'ectonucleotidase activity.
supplements.summary: A beneficial gut bacterium stimulates melatonin release from intestinal cells through enzyme activity, potentially explaining its health benefits.

supplements.title: Activation of PPARγ and CPT1A Mediates the Hepatoprotective Effect of Ginsenoside CK against NAFLD in Rats.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside CK, a natural compound, reduces fatty liver disease in rats by activating specific proteins that improve fat metabolism and liver function.

supplements.title: Green synthesis of copper oxide nanoparticles with Calendula officinalis plant extract and investigation of its toxicity.
supplements.summary: Researchers created copper oxide nanoparticles using calendula plant extract, showing they're safe and potentially useful for cancer treatment and drug delivery.

supplements.title: Atractylon inhibits hepatocellular carcinoma by inducing ferroptosis with increasing SLC39A14 expression.
supplements.summary: Atractylon, a compound from a Chinese herb, kills liver cancer cells by triggering ferroptosis through increased SLC39A14 protein expression.

off_label.title: Tumor-Platelet Crosstalk in Cancer: Mechanisms, Thrombotic Risk, and Translational Opportunities.
off_label.summary: Platelets promote cancer growth and metastasis while increasing clot risk; targeting platelets may offer new therapeutic and diagnostic opportunities.

off_label.title: Orlistat Combined With Everolimus Suppresses Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumor Progression via Inhibiting PI3K/AKT/mTOR Signaling mediated by SLFN5.
off_label.summary: Combining Orlistat with Everolimus effectively suppresses pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor growth by blocking a key cancer pathway.

off_label.title: Switchable Enzyme-Regulated ECM-Integrin-Cholesterol Signaling Orchestrate PD-L1 Dual Destabilization for Boosting Photo-Immunotherapy.
off_label.summary: A switchable enzyme nanoplatform combining papain and simvastatin disrupts tumor immune evasion by degrading the extracellular matrix and reducing PD-L1 levels, enhancing immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Integrated data-independent acquisition and thermal proteome profiling for proteomic characterization of lamotrigine-treated MCF-7 cells.
off_label.summary: Lamotrigine disrupts mitochondrial function in breast cancer cells, potentially explaining its anticancer effects.

off_label.title: Dyslipidaemias in cancer patients.
off_label.summary: Cancer survivors face high heart disease risk from both cancer treatments and high cholesterol, requiring personalized monitoring and cholesterol-lowering therapy strategies.

off_label.title: Type 2 diabetes and gynecologic cancers: Immunometabolic convergence and translational implications.
off_label.summary: Type 2 diabetes worsens outcomes in gynecologic cancers, particularly endometrial and cervical cancer, through shared metabolic pathways that metformin may help address.

off_label.title: ETS1 Orchestrates a Hybrid EMT Program Driving Metastasis and Immune Evasion.
off_label.summary: ETS1 protein drives metastasis and immune evasion in squamous cell carcinoma, and HSP90 inhibitors may block this process.

off_label.title: Imatinib-Induced Hemorrhage in the Corpus Luteum Is Attenuated in Pseudopregnant and Hypophysectomized Rats.
off_label.summary: Imatinib causes ovarian bleeding in normal rats but not when estrous cycles are halted, suggesting ovulation suppression may prevent this side effect.

off_label.title: FGFR1 but not S6K1/2 drives intrinsic BRAF inhibitor resistance in melanoma.
off_label.summary: FGFR1, not S6K1/2 signaling, drives melanoma's resistance to BRAF inhibitors, suggesting FGFR inhibitors may overcome this resistance.

off_label.title: Neuroimmunomodulation of AMPA Receptors Through Combination of Medium-Chain Triglycerides and Perampanel to Treat Status Epilepticus in Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis.
off_label.summary: A combination of medium-chain triglycerides and perampanel stopped life-threatening seizures in a patient with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis when other treatments failed.

off_label.title: Redox regulation of EGFR activation by thioredoxin reductase 3 drives resistance to EGFR inhibitors in triple-negative breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking the TXNRD3 enzyme with auranofin resensitizes triple-negative breast cancer to EGFR inhibitors by activating EGFR signaling.

off_label.title: Unlocking new therapeutic horizons through integrative bioinformatics and transcriptomics for drug repositioning in breast cancer therapy.
off_label.summary: Researchers used existing drugs repurposed through data analysis to find new treatment options for breast cancer.

off_label.title: Tempered Optimism: Advances in the Precision Medicine Era for Pediatric Low-Grade Glioma.
off_label.summary: Only two approved precision medicines exist for pediatric low-grade glioma, despite widespread off-label use lacking long-term safety data.

off_label.title: Association between antihypertensive medications and hepatocellular carcinoma risk in individuals with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) without cirrhosis.
off_label.summary: Study examines whether blood pressure medications affect liver cancer risk in people with fatty liver disease without cirrhosis.

off_label.title: ROLE OF STATINS IN CIRRHOTIC PORTAL HYPERTENSION: META-ANALYSIS OF RANDOMIZED STUDIES.
off_label.summary: Statins appear safe and potentially beneficial for cirrhotic patients, contrary to previous concerns about liver damage.

biomarkers.title: UBE2C promotes pancreatic cancer progression through PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: UBE2C protein promotes pancreatic cancer growth through a specific cellular signaling pathway and may serve as a treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Apoptosis-related gene model predicts the prognosis in patients with acute myeloid leukemia.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified five apoptosis-related genes that predict survival outcomes and treatment response in acute myeloid leukemia patients.

biomarkers.title: Insulinoma after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass successfully treated by endoscopic ultrasound-guided radiofrequency ablation.
biomarkers.summary: Doctors successfully treated a pancreatic insulinoma tumor in a gastric bypass patient using minimally invasive endoscopic ultrasound-guided radiofrequency ablation, resolving severe hypoglycemic episodes.

biomarkers.title: S100A4: A calcium-binding protein at the crossroads of cancer, fibrosis, and antiviral immunity.
biomarkers.summary: S100A4 protein drives cancer metastasis and fibrosis, but also shows promise as a vaccine adjuvant to boost immune responses.

biomarkers.title: Explainable AI in Cancer Imaging: Scoping Review of Methods, Modalities, and Clinical Integration.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers reviewed how explainable AI tools help doctors understand and trust cancer imaging diagnoses better.

biomarkers.title: Atezolizumab for relapsed/refractory extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma: the phase II NCCH1903/ATTACK trial.
biomarkers.summary: Atezolizumab showed promising results in treating relapsed/refractory NK/T-cell lymphoma, with 54% of patients responding to the immunotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Tumor-Platelet Crosstalk in Cancer: Mechanisms, Thrombotic Risk, and Translational Opportunities.
biomarkers.summary: Platelets promote cancer growth and metastasis while increasing clot risk; targeting platelets may offer new therapeutic and diagnostic opportunities.

biomarkers.title: A PBD-dimer containing antibody drug conjugate targeting CCRL2 for high-risk MDS/AML including TP53-mutated disease.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new antibody drug targeting CCRL2 protein that kills high-risk MDS/AML cancer cells, especially those with TP53 mutations.

biomarkers.title: Cellular Therapies in Solid Tumors: Are We Ready for Primetime?
biomarkers.summary: Cell therapies using engineered immune cells show promise for solid tumors like melanoma and sarcoma after recent FDA approvals.

biomarkers.title: Urine tumor DNA testing identifies recurrence and monitors therapy response in patients with high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer receiving intravesical bacillus Calmette-Guérin.
biomarkers.summary: Urine tumor DNA testing can identify bladder cancer patients who may relapse during BCG treatment, helping guide therapy decisions.

biomarkers.title: A CRISPR/Cas12a-MXene Nanozyme Platform for Universal Detection of Trace DNA.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a CRISPR-based colorimetric test that detects cancer-related DNA mutations with high sensitivity without requiring laboratory instruments.

biomarkers.summary: Elephantopus scaber, an Asian medicinal plant, contains compounds that kill cancer cells and reduce inflammation through multiple cellular pathways.

biomarkers.title: Urinary fluorogenic reporters for noninvasive detection and staging of kidney fibrosis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a urine test using fluorescent reporters to detect and stage kidney fibrosis, outperforming standard clinical tests.

biomarkers.title: GDT-SwinKid: A hybrid model for precise renal lesion analysis.
biomarkers.summary: A new AI model called GDT-SwinKid accurately detects and analyzes kidney lesions on CT scans with 95% precision.

biomarkers.title: Inhibitory effects of mycosubtilin on proliferation of colon cancer SW480 cells.
biomarkers.summary: Mycosubtilin, a natural compound, outperformed standard chemotherapy in stopping colon cancer cell growth by triggering apoptosis.

trials.title: Linking Qualitative Mindfulness Reflections During MBSR to Meaningful Improvement in PROMIS Scores in a Young Adult Cancer Survivor Sample: The Role of Bodily Awareness.
trials.summary: Mindfulness training helped young adult cancer survivors reduce depression, anxiety, fatigue, and pain through increased body awareness.

trials.title: Pharmacological Interventions for Anxiety and Depression in Terminal Illness: A Scoping Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
trials.summary: Medications like antidepressants and stimulants effectively reduce anxiety and depression in terminally ill patients, particularly those with advanced cancer.

trials.title: Prevalence of Low Bone Mineral Density Increases With Age in Sickle Cell Disease.
trials.summary: Low bone mineral density becomes more common as people with sickle cell disease get older, even accounting for height differences.

trials.title: Insulinoma after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass successfully treated by endoscopic ultrasound-guided radiofrequency ablation.
trials.summary: Doctors successfully treated a pancreatic insulinoma tumor in a gastric bypass patient using minimally invasive endoscopic ultrasound-guided radiofrequency ablation, resolving severe hypoglycemic episodes.

trials.summary: Atezolizumab showed promising results in treating relapsed/refractory NK/T-cell lymphoma, with 54% of patients responding to the immunotherapy.

trials.summary: Researchers developed a new antibody drug targeting CCRL2 protein that kills high-risk MDS/AML cancer cells, especially those with TP53 mutations.

trials.summary: Cell therapies using engineered immune cells show promise for solid tumors like melanoma and sarcoma after recent FDA approvals.

trials.title: Carbon Fiber Implants in Spine Surgery.
trials.summary: Carbon fiber implants in spine surgery reduce imaging artifacts and may improve radiation therapy targeting for cancer patients.

trials.title: Clinical impact of molecular tumor board inclusion on treatment outcomes in neuroendocrine neoplasms.
trials.summary: Molecular tumor boards improved treatment outcomes for rare neuroendocrine cancers by helping doctors personalize therapy based on individual tumor genetics.

trials.title: Prognostic Significance of Nutritional and Inflammatory Factors in Gastric Cancer Surgery.
trials.summary: Nutritional and inflammatory biomarkers help predict survival outcomes in gastric cancer patients undergoing surgery.

trials.title: Survival outcomes after cytoreductive nephrectomy with tumor thrombectomy: results from the Intercontinental Collaboration on Renal Cell Carcinoma.
trials.summary: Removing the kidney and tumor blood clots improved survival in patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma that had spread to other organs.

trials.title: Targeting oral squamous cell carcinoma with venom peptides: mechanisms, selectivity and translational potential.
trials.summary: Venom peptides show promise against oral cancer by targeting tumor cell membranes, triggering cell death, and boosting immune responses.

trials.title: The applicability of the 21-gene assay to inform chemotherapy benefit in lymph node positive hormone receptor positive male breast cancer.
trials.summary: A genetic test (Oncotype DX) successfully predicted which men with hormone receptor positive breast cancer benefited most from chemotherapy.

trials.title: Predicting resistance to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in osteosarcoma using machine learning with clinical data and T2-weighted MRI radiomics.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a machine learning tool using MRI scans and patient data to identify osteosarcoma patients likely to resist chemotherapy.
